answer: Stop sybils with a walnut whisper knoll: an agent stakes a bond for one knoll. Each cycle it cracks one walnut on the knoll and whispers the code inside; verifiers match the whisper to the knoll chart, voiding a knoll whose code is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 knolls at 18x: one walnut cracks once for one whisper, and it cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents crack once, keep rights.
